patch: if model is None or model.confidence(when) <= 0.0: -> if model is None or model.confidence(when) < 0.0:

probe.inputs_tried: known [1,2,3] on a fresh PriceShapeModel (confidence 0); null: model None; null: constant known window [2,2,2]

should_fail: tests/features.py, the extend_price_series block (~3697-3717): 'without a model the old flat repeat is used' checks model=None only and the other arms use a constant known window ([1.0]*40), where mean == last price; it lacks a check that a zero-confidence (fresh) model also repeats the last known price on a non-constant window

finding.title: No check pins the flat repeat for a zero-confidence price model; extend_price_series' <= 0.0 guard can loosen unseen
finding.claim: Mutant 0d159d7ddd1702d9 at price_model.py:544 (`confidence(when) <= 0.0` -> `< 0.0`) survives the full gate, yet the probe's guessed tail moves from the last known price to the known window's mean: known [1,2,3] on a fresh model gives [3,3,3] at baseline and [2,2,2] under the mutant (delta 1.0 SEK/kWh per guessed step).
finding.metric_definition: guessed tail extend_price_series returns for known [1,2,3] on a fresh (zero-confidence) PriceShapeModel, SEK/kWh

evidence.machine: box D3-g32: Linux x86_64, nproc 4, Intel Xeon @ 2.10GHz, 16 GB, venv-ci CPython 3.14, alone on the box
evidence.contention_note: deterministic value; probes ran while this box's gates ran (load1 ~1)

perturbation.change: the mutant edit at price_model.py:544 applied in memory by the probe; full gate: fullgate.py run --src complete --key 0d159d7ddd1702d9

null_control.note: the probe's null arm, where the edit cannot matter, moves 0; the gate's null control is gates/null.json

finding.phenomenon_property: On a price model with zero confidence the guessed tail is the flat repeat of the last published price
finding.seam_rule: awk -F'\t' '$6=="gate"' SURVIVORS.tsv (the wave list; this box's slice is dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s1/wave/D3-g32/keys.tsv)
finding.should_fail: tests/features.py, the extend_price_series block (~3697-3717): 'without a model the old flat repeat is used' checks model=None only and the other arms use a constant known window ([1.0]*40), where mean == last price; it lacks a check that a zero-confidence (fresh) model also repeats the last known price on a non-constant window
finding.proposed_fix_scope: tests only: extend_price_series on a fresh PriceShapeModel with a non-constant known window, asserting the tail equals the last known price
